correctness.rationale: For odd prime p, center preservation is proved from the RB identity; quotient additivity forces \(\mathbb F_p\)-linear A and center scalar k. Alternating polarization gives \(\det A=k(1+\operatorname{tr}A)\) iff the explicit unique quadratic-linear normal form works. Matrix fiber cardinalities use \(M_p(t,d)=p(p+\chi(t^2-4d))\); GL2 similarity gives \(p^2\) liftable and p nonliftable types; dual bijections are characterized by det A and det(I+A). The exact 4-cell counts follow from two excluded determinant fibers and are verified by exhaustive p=3 group checks and p=3,5,7,11 parameter calculations. Finite checks are supplemental to the symbolic proof.
